auto_throttle.desc: 30-frame rolling frame-time average; degrade at 33ms, recover at 23ms (hysteresis band prevents flapping). ~15 lines. Highest-value lift for phone.
auto_throttle.js: avg=rolling(30); if(avg>33) degrade(); else if(avg<23.1) recover(); // degrade: fewer agents, hide layers; recover: restore

home_radius.desc: Every agent has a home territory it drifts back to. 5 lines. Makes 42 agents look purposeful.
home_radius.mapping: couriers outer radii, harvesters at wells, synthesizers at Crystallis

discovery.desc: Proximity + uuid dedup + quantized reward. Template for Seeker/AnimalPath.

leaky_integrator.desc: Attention meter: events bump (capped), bleeds when idle. 1 line.

echo_accrual: Unbounded interaction counter scaling persistent influence: ring=0.008+echoCount*0.002 (cap 0.025). Use: NarakaPath yeet-priority accrues on repeated flags.
scan: Radius-gated, once-only, small random reward, capped global bump. Template for planet inspection granting intel.
memory_fabric: Attention-weighted edges with zero graph library: opacity=(0.02+0.02*pulse)*echoFactor*(1-dist/15).
